correctness.rationale: The identity A=J+I-B^T B gives the true 1-eigenspace ker B of dimension n(n-3)/2; the orthogonal projector has diagonal (n-3)/(n-1). For h in ker B, h_e<=1 transforms bijectively to By=1,y>=0 via h=1-(n-1)y. Positive-support independence at an extreme fractional one-factor forces isolated weight-one edges and disjoint half-weight odd cycles. With q odd-cycle vertices, ||h||^2=n(n-1)(n-2)/2-(n-1)^2 q/4, so qmin=0 even or 3 odd gives exactly the proposed radius and all contact-facet counts. Irreducibility of the edge-permutation representation restricted to ker B plus uniqueness forces centered John/Löwner balls. Independently checked projector/radius algebra for n=5..13; finite checks do not establish the representation result, which follows from the scalar commutant argument. Normalization by orthonormal eigenvectors is essential.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroborative and do not replace the all-parameter mathematical proof.
